subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR land a narrow pre-compaction pruning/prefix change now, or keep the unintegrated multi-pass scaffold for a fuller compaction architecture direction?
rationale: The concrete correctness blockers are fixable, but the PR still contains an XL internal multi-pass scaffold that is not wired into production callers and overlaps the broader compaction architecture item.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Keep only the pieces that are wired into current compaction after fixing preserved-turn pruning and removing dormant public settings fields.

options.title: Sponsor Full Multi-Pass Integration
options.body: Keep the scaffold only if a maintainer wants this branch to become the production multi-pass integration with upgrade and live-run proof.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Pause or close this conflicting XL branch if the remaining work is better handled by a smaller PR against https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398.

recommendation.title: Narrow Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep only the pieces that are wired into current compaction after fixing preserved-turn pruning and removing dormant public settings fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to `sallyom`, while the historical compaction ownership is shared across prior contributors.
